title: Word frequency
task: Implement top_words(text, n) in words.py: split the text into words (runs of ASCII letters and apostrophes), count them, and return the n most common as a list of (word, count) tuples, most common first. Add tests.
follow_up: Review finding on top_words: counting is case-sensitive ('The' and 'the' are counted apart) and words with equal counts come out in an arbitrary order. Count case-insensitively, report words in lowercase, and break ties alphabetically. Add tests for both.
